title: A股剧烈探底回升：科创50暴涨10.73%，创近一年最大单日涨幅，半导体ETF涨超19%
summary: 2026年7月21日，科创50指数触底强势反弹，收涨10.73%至1903.16点，半导体芯片ETF单日涨幅超19%；多只科技/芯片股触及涨停板，深成指涨4.81%，创业板指涨7.05%。此为科创50历史单日涨幅第三高。
why: A股半导体板块深V反转，直接影响HK半导体/科技标的联动预期；若强势持续，有助压缩相关港股期权隐含波动率、或催生Covered Call机会。

title: 证监会两日连开座谈会要求增强市场内在稳定性；全市场股票ETF连续11日净流入3567亿元，刷新单周历史纪录
summary: 证监会主席吴清7月20-21日分别召开座谈会，强调全力维护市场平稳运行，要求上市公司提升核心竞争力、更好回报投资者。同期，全市场股票ETF连续11个交易日净流入，区间累计达3567亿元；7月17日单日净流入758.67亿元为史上第三高，单周净流入突破2036亿元刷新历史纪录。
why: 监管层高规格密集表态叠加ETF历史性资金流入，显示政策底强化，有助于支撑中国权益资产估值；对持有港股/A股的仓位而言，整体市场情绪边际向好，Sell Put风险溢价或可适度收窄。

title: Tesla TSLA Q2 2026 earnings due after close today: 480K record deliveries; revenue est. $27.6B; Robotaxi now in 6 U.S. cities
summary: Tesla reports Q2 2026 results tonight (July 22). Deliveries hit a record 480,126 units, beating consensus by ~74,000 vehicles. Wall Street expects $27.58B revenue (auto $20.1B, energy $3.8B), $0.36 GAAP EPS, 19.5% gross margin. Tesla's Miami Robotaxi service launched July 5, now expanding across six U.S. cities. Options pricing a 7.6% post-earnings swing.
why: 特斯拉Q2业绩是今夜最重要催化剂之一；交付创纪录但利润率存疑，结果将决定是否适合短期Sell Put或博隐含波动率压缩；Robotaxi进展亦影响自动驾驶板块估值预期。

title: Alphabet GOOGL Q2 2026 earnings due after close today: Google Cloud est. +67% YoY to $22.8B; $180-190B AI capex in focus
summary: Alphabet reports Q2 2026 after market close July 22. Consensus: $116.98B revenue, $2.89-$2.95 EPS. Google Cloud seen at $22.8B (+67% YoY), following Q1's record 32.9% operating margin. Gemini API processing 16B tokens/minute (+60% QoQ). Full-year capex guidance raised to $180-190B. Gemini 3.5 Pro delays flagged as a risk heading into results.
why: 谷歌业绩是今夜美股科技板块另一焦点，云增速能否维持67%+直接影响AI基础设施叙事；超大规模capex考验AI投资回报预期，结果影响英伟达、英特尔等供应链标的隔日走势。

title: Trump orders fresh strikes on Iran nuclear/power sites; Brent crude surges 5%+; Dow drops 576 pts; IMF cuts 2026 growth to 3.0%
summary: President Trump declared the U.S.-Iran ceasefire 'over' in July and ordered fresh airstrikes on Iranian nuclear and power facilities (latest July 15). Brent crude settled +5.43% at $78.19/bbl, WTI +4.37%. The Dow fell 576 points on initial announcement; energy stocks gained while travel/airlines fell 2-3%. IMF downgraded 2026 global growth forecast to 3.0% (from 3.5%). Iran warned of retaliation.
why: 中东地缘冲突持续推升能源通胀，压制美联储降息空间；高油价对全球消费股（旅游/餐饮/海底捞/携程）构成逆风，同时推高市场整体隐含波动率，Sell Put需更高安全边际。

title: SK Hynix rockets +14% July 21 as chip stocks stage broad rebound; Micron +13% in tandem; July 29 earnings as next test
summary: SK Hynix (SKHY) surged 14% to $172.80 in U.S. trading on July 21, leading a broad AI chip and memory rally after a 10%+ monthly pullback (including a record single-day -15.4% on July 13). Micron rose 13% in sympathy, extending momentum from its blowout Q3 FY2026 ($41.46B revenue; Q4 guidance $50B ±$1B). SK Hynix Q2 earnings due July 29 will be the next verification of the HBM super-cycle narrative.
why: 存储芯片板块强势反弹印证HBM需求周期延续，对SK海力士、美光等持仓均有利；财报前高波动率可考虑Sell Put建仓策略，但需防范类似7月13日的黑天鹅波动。

title: Fed FOMC meeting July 28-29: rate hold at 3.50-3.75% widely expected; energy-driven inflation at 4.2% remains key risk
summary: Market-implied odds favor no rate change at ~79.5% at the July 28-29 FOMC meeting. June CPI showed 4.2% YoY inflation driven by a 23.5% surge in energy costs amid Middle East tensions. Fed June minutes noted AI investment, tariffs and Middle East as new potential inflation sources. 19.4% odds of a 25bp hike remain. Decision July 29 at 2pm ET.
why: 美联储政策路径直接影响美股估值折现率；若因油价推升通胀维持鹰派倾向，对高PE科技股和港股消费标的形成压力，也影响期权隐含利率曲线定价和整体风险溢价水平。

title: Intel Foundry lands Fortinet as first publicly named cybersecurity chip customer; co-developing next-gen firewall ASIC on Intel 4
summary: Intel and Fortinet announced July 21 that Fortinet will be Intel Foundry's first named external cybersecurity customer, using the Intel 4 process node (not 18A) to co-develop Fortinet's next-gen Security Processor 6 (SP6) ASIC for firewalls. Intel stock reclaimed the $100 level. This is CEO Lip-Bu Tan's first public foundry customer win since taking over in March 2025, ahead of Intel's Q2 earnings July 23.
why: 英特尔代工业务首获公开命名客户是里程碑，验证Foundry策略可信度；若7/23 Q2财报配合18A良率数据，可能推动INTC估值重估，对现有仓位可关注财报后Covered Call时机。

title: Nvidia discloses 9.3% stake in Nebius Group (NBIS) worth ~$5B via SEC filing; NBIS surges 13%+
summary: Nvidia disclosed in an SEC filing (July 21) that it holds ~22.3M Class A Nebius shares via outright ownership plus pre-funded warrants, raising its stake to 9.3% valued at ~$5B at current prices. The original $2B strategic investment was made March 11, 2026. Nebius, an AI cloud infrastructure company, jumped more than 13% on the news. Nvidia also guided Q2 revenue at ~$91B.
why: 英伟达战略扩股Nebius，显示其布局AI云基础设施生态的决心，印证AI算力需求旺盛；同时$91B Q2营收指引若兑现将进一步巩固NVDA多头逻辑，对整个AI供应链板块有积极示范效应。

title: Intel INTC Q2 2026 earnings tomorrow (July 23): 18A foundry yield at 85%; Apple/Microsoft as design partners; options pricing 15% swing
summary: Intel reports Q2 2026 on July 23 after market close. Street expects $14.42B revenue, $0.21 EPS. Key watch: Intel 18A foundry yield reportedly improved to 85% (from ~65%); Apple and Microsoft confirmed as 18A design partners; Nvidia and OpenAI reportedly placed foundry orders. Stock at ~$95.70, +163% YTD. Options pricing a ~15% post-earnings move.
why: 英特尔Q2是本周半导体赛道最大财报事件；18A良率若官方确认突破85%，将触发代工业务重估行情；期权隐含波动率高达15%，熟悉INTC的投资者可考虑Sell Straddle/Strangle，但需注意二元事件风险。

title: 腾讯牵头约136亿元（约20亿美元）收购AI Agent独角兽Manus，将成最大股东，强化微信智能体生态
summary: 2026年7月20日，腾讯牵头中国资本财团以约20亿美元估值从Meta手中赎回Manus全部股权，腾讯将成最大单一股东。此前Meta于2025年12月以同等价格收购Manus，但中国发改委外资安全审查终止了该交易。Manus当前ARR已从百万增至40-50亿美元，实际成交约4-5倍PS比；收购后Manus有望直接整合入微信/元宝AI生态。
why: 腾讯以相对低估的价格获取全球领先的AI Agent资产，有助落地微信智能体功能、巩固混元生态竞争力；对0700.HK是正面催化剂，可关注消息落地后估值修复空间，也适合结合回购进度布局Sell Put。

title: Circle CRCL faces new Fed stablecoin rules as GENIUS Act July 18 transition deadline passes; USDC oversight tightens
summary: The GENIUS Act's one-year transition period expired July 18, 2026, requiring the Federal Reserve, Treasury, and other agencies to release implementation guidance on reserve standards, licensing, and USDC oversight. Circle (CRCL) stock remained under pressure ahead of the deadline, with key technical support near $61.70 and downside risk toward $49. Stricter capital and disclosure requirements could increase Circle's compliance costs.
why: Circle是直接持有标的，GENIUS Act监管细则落地是关键催化事件；若规则偏严将压缩盈利空间，推升合规成本，对CRCL估值负面；若明确且可控，则有助消除不确定性溢价，可关注Sell Put建仓节奏。

title: Xiaomi unveils 'Pengcheng' EREV extended-range SUV series (Sky Nomad) on July 9, accelerating premium auto push
summary: Xiaomi unveiled a new extended-range electric SUV lineup branded 'Pengcheng' (Sky Nomad) on July 9, using a combustion engine as range-extender — positioned against Tesla Model X and other premium SUVs. As of end-June 2026, Xiaomi had delivered 258,232 YU7 crossovers cumulatively since launch (Jun 2025), vs Tesla Model Y's 471,207 units in China over the same window.
why: 小米汽车拓展至增程SUV高利润市场，有助提升1810.HK长期盈利预期；但需关注国内EV竞争白热化及新车型量产周期，对Sell Put布局可参考新车型发布节奏作为隐含波动率锚点。
